balls.text: nice way to round off the innings, shuffles across the stumps and paddles a low full toss over short fine leg

Direct hit and Narine has to go but all sorts of things happened there. The yorker was squirted back to Awana who deflected the ball to the on side, the fielder had a shy at the batsman's end and there was an overthrow, Johnson then picked up and fired the throw to the bowler's end and knocked down the stump, Narine was well short but Bailey who was behind the stumps for the throw nudged a bail, the bail didn;t fall but Johnson's throw uprooted the stump, the third umpire took his time and it was a legit call
good comeback by Awana, fires the yorker and he can only drill it back to the bowler
fullish ball on the stumps and drilled to long-on, they hurry the second, Chawla comes in the way of the throw and is hit on the back
fine leg is up and Awana makes the mistake of dropping it short down the leg side, free swing to the fine leg rope
good way to start the final over, a low full toss on the pads, he easily whips it down to fine leg, fielder dives in vain
fires it full on the stumps and he drives on the up towards mid-on
he beats him on the drive outside the off stump
caught at the boundary's edge, Johnson bowled that full on the pads, ten Doeschate was aiming to flick that over deep midwicket, a little more muscle would have sent it over, Vohra barely had to move
looked like the slower bouncer, 124 kph, ten Doeschate doesn't read it and swings too early but misses
Johnson bowls this full on the pads and he whips it down to deep square leg
good length on the body and he shuffles and works it away down to fine leg
his cameo has ended, Yadav shuffles across his stumps and exposes the leg stump, Karanveer bowls that straight on the stumps and hits middle and leg
excellent placement! Tossed up on middle and leg, he gets on his knee and sweeps him firlmy to deep midwicket, bisects the gap between two fielders there
looks to sweep and gets hit on the pad
swung towards long-on and in the air but on the first bounce
higher and further! Tossed up and he gets on his knee and slams that over long-on again, mad scramble for the ball there
minimum effort and maximum reward, ten Doeschate comes down the pitch to a flighted ball and checks his chipped shot and yet sends it a few rows over wide long-on
slower ball on the pads and he works it to midwicket
that's good running, tucks it into the vacant gap at midwicket, ten Doeschate hurries him for the second
a low inswinging full toss on the pads and he works it away to fine leg
good comeback as Dhawan swings it in and Yadav gets an inside edge to the boot
another impressive stroke, this was fuller and Yadav made a hint of room and lofted it effortlessly down the ground
this was the pick up shot, this was a good length ball on middle and he swings and sends it a few rows over deep square leg
he stays back and punches it towards long-off
looks to whip it away and the ball hits high on the pad
makes room to punch it through the off side but gets an inside edge to the pad
he stays back and punches it to the off side
on the pads and he knocks it to the on side
looks to cut but misses, stifled appeal

oh well Rishi makes a mess of it at third man, spinning away and Suryakumar follows the turn and dabs it wide of slip, Dhawan chases it and doesn't time the dive right, tries to pull it back but fails, tries again and again and the ball beats him
Suryakumar quietly defends the hat-trick ball off the back foot

Karanveer is on a hat-trick and KKR lose Yusuf as well! This was a fairly soft dismissal, tossed up on middle and leg and Yusus looks to chip this over long-on but doesn't do so with conviction, catching practice for Miller again
he looks to go downtown again but fails this time, tossed up and he was looking to swipe this across the line, miscued and Miller runs to his left from long-off and sets off
as straight as it gets! Tossed up on middle, Shakib cleared the front leg, made room to launch that over the bowler and long-off
comes back in and he drives back to the bowler
strange shot by Shakib, he punches it on the up towards mid-off
swings it towards the pads and he works it towards midwicket
wakes up this time with a six over long-off, this was full and he made room and launched it into the crowd
hits the pads and lobs up and drops on the pitch
close call for Yusuf as Kings XI appeal for a run out, this was tucked towards square leg and Yusuf set off and was sent back, did the dive and Awana's throw was to the keeper, he made his ground
fires it full and he can only push it down to mid-off
swings it back in and he tucks it off the pads
appeal for an lbw, he was looking to softly push this to the on side and the ball came back in,struck on the back leg but on the thigh pad, Llong thought it may have cleared the stumps
a bit short and he hops and dabs it down to third man
good counter attack, this was hammered on a length and he comes down the track and pounds it down to deep extra cover
outside off and cut towards point
punched towards mid-off and the throw to the bowler;s end was wide and they claim the overthrow, Karanveer is irritated
full on the pads and he works it to midwicket
edged and no slip, this was wide outside off and he chased it and he gets an outside edge that beat Saha
the keeper is up, he gives him some width and he cuts him to point
he tucks it towards deep square leg
this was a yorker fired on the pads and it was a bit too quick for Yusuf, hit on the legs and Johnson appeals, missing leg.. oh wait! maybe that was hitting, need to see another replay of that
much better from Yusuf, another short one but this was angling across, he followed the angle and arched back and carved it over point, used the pace and didn't hit it too hard
awkward looking shot by Yusuf, this was short and on the body and he doesn't make proper contact
fuller and in the length to drive and he places it to the deep but straight to the sweeper
nearly bisects the gap between two men in the deep on the on side, he pulls and deep midwiclet slides and cuts it off
hammers it on a good length and cramps him up for room, he punches it down the track
he slides this one wide down the leg side
drops it wide outside off and he punches it to point
slides that wide outside off
fetches it from off and middle and sweeps him
fuller one and he drags it across the line to long-on
slower through the air and he shuffles and softly clips it to the on side
he drops it short and Shakib mistimes the punch to point
looks to drive and gets an inside edge to the leg side
gets forward and pushes it to the off side

double strike by Akshar and an unfortunate way to get out, he shuffled across the stumps and the ball hit the thigh pad and lobbed up, Pandey wasn't quite sure where the ball was and the ball knocked off the leg bail
flatter one outside off and pushed to the off side
finds long-off with precision, tossed up on the off stump, he leans forward and looks to clear long-off and doesn't fully go through with it, Miller stayed put and took it comfortably
flatter delivery and he goes back, makes room and punches it to  the off side
he goes back and cuts towards point, good stop
he was fully in control of this, this was tossed up outside off and he leans forward and lofts it clean over cover
lofts it over cover and only just

how lucky was he? That landed in between two fielders, Pandey looks to slog against the turn, miscued it and it was in the air, Miller ran forward from long-on, Karanveer turned around and ran and it fell in the middle
waits for the turn and works it towards mid-on
he stays back and works it to the on side
looks to slash that to third man boundary  but Sehwag does well to dive in the circle and stop that
length ball and he pulls it towards long-on
he stays back and punches it to the off side
goes back and works it to the on side
bounce and turn for Akshar, he looks to dab it to third man and is beaten
he gets an inside edge towards midwicket and sets off
pushed it with soft hands towards mid-on and they do well to take a quick single, beat the throw
thrashed down the ground, this was a slower ball on the stumps and pitched up, moved across and drilled it down the pitch and wide of the bowler
nearly edged that, he was forward and across and the ball skidded past the bat, Saha breaks the stumps immediately and appeals for a stumping, Pandey drags the back foot back in time
he gets forward and across and pushes it to the off side
welcomes Dhawan to the crease with an effortless six over the sight screen, this was pitched up, he moved across to the pitch of the ball and scooped it downtown
he gets an inside edge that sneaks past the stumps
that was flat! A short one from Awana, he fetched that from the off stump and pulled it over midwicket, the ball lands just short of the rope
he had to hurry there, this was pushed with soft hands towards mid-off and set off, Bailey underarms the throw but missed the stumps
he opens the face and dabs it to third man, the fielder is fine
take that! After getting beaten the previous ball Uthappa comes down the pitch and slams that in the air over extra cover, listen to the roar
he looks to launch that over the on side, moves across the stumps and nearly gets an inside edge
Johnson tempts him to go for the expansive off drive by bowling it wide outside off, he goes for it and nearly edges it
this was bowled fuller outside off and he opens the face and runs it to third man
in the air but very safe, didn't look in control initially, length ball on the pads, played a checked drive in the air and wide of mid-on
148 kph, that was coming quick at Uthappa, it was short and he read the length early, went forward and adjusted and pulled it over deep square leg
good length outside off and he dabs it towards third man
he slides down the leg side

close call for Pandey! This was a fuller ball on the stumps and Pandey drove at it half heartedly and spooned it towards mid-off, Bailey was a few yards in front and the ball was to his right, he did his best to dive but couldn't get a hand to it
fine leg was up, he fired it on middle and leg and he shuffled and made it possible to flick it wide of short fine leg
works it against the turn down to square leg
down to deep midwicket this time and it's a length ball he puts away
fuller and he works it wide of midwicket
tucks it towards midwicket for a single
tossed up on the pads and he nudges it to the on side
good length on middle and leg and he works it to midwicket
he fires in another yorker and this time outside off, he bends and squirts it out to third man
aiming for the inswinging yorker and Uthappa does well to flick that to fine leg
another short one and Pandey negotiated it well, kept it down and dabbed it wide of point

the captain departs early! Gambhir gets a short ball and he fetches that from the off stump and looks to pull him in front of square, couldn't get enough on it to clear the infield and Bailey jumped and took it above his head at mid-on, he was fielding a few yards in front
appeal for an lbw by Johnson and it was a confident shout, this was coming back in and struck him on the thigh pad, that would have cleared the stumps
Uthappa moves across and punches it down the track
appeals for a catch down the leg side, this was short and on the ribs and he looked to nudge it away and it wasn't far from the gloves
keeps it nice and straight and he stays behind the line and punches it back to the bowler
cramped him up for room but Gambhir managed to chop that on towards short third man and set off
off the mark this time with a dab down to third man, gets forward and across
struck on the pads first up, he was looking to play across the line and may have missed leg
and ends the formalities with a slower ball and Johnson makes room but can't get bat on ball, no use - Kings XI have been caught napping at Eden tonight
this was fired outside off and he made room to slap this but missed
that's a good bouncer, really quick for Johnson and he swings and misses
slower one to Johnson and he makes room to swing and misses
fires a length ball on the stumps and he makes room to push it to cover and only a single
Umesh begins the over by getting rid of Bailey, this was a length ball on the off stump and he looked to swing this over long-on but he picked Pandey, easy take
how do you out him away? Another swing and a miss against an off break
this one stopped on him as he miscued the pull to the vacant area at square leg
swings and only gets an outside edge, Kings XI really struggling
skidded through and he punched it to the off side
sharp turn again and he made room and looked to slash but missed
Johnson looks to slog this away, big offcutter and he misses
two in the over! This was a low full toss and Bailey was down the track and sent it a few rows over deep midwicket
swings the first ball away! Tossed up on middle and he gets on his knee and deposits it a few rows over wide long-on
an easy stumping, Dhawan was down the pitch looking to hit out, the ball skidded through, beat him and Uthappa did the rest
palmed over the rope! On the leg stump and he slogs it flat down to fine leg and Umesh was at the edge and it was over his head but he couldn't hang on
full ball and he drives to wide long-off and Suryakumar does well to slide and cut it off, nearly fluffed it
he finally connects well, tossed up on the off stump and he gets on his knee and sends it a few rows over deep midwicket
Bailey makes room and looks to smash it through the off side and misses
on the pads and clips it over midwicket
Dhawan was looking to slow that from outside off and he missed it completely
stays back and mistimes it towards mid-on, it was in the air
is it too late? This was a short one from Narine outside off asking to be hit, he punches it hard down to deep cover
gets forward and pushes it down to long-off
he gets forward and sweeps but only a single
good bowling, no room to free his arms, pushes it back to the bowler
he comes down the track and lofts it down to wide long-on
he makes room and punches it down to mid-off
tossed up on the stumps and swept towards fine leg
nearly lobbed to the fielder, he made room and looked to cut but got an outside edge towards point
drops it short and he goes back and punches it to cover
he comes down the track and drives him to cover
he comes down the track and drills this down to long-off
down the track and he is forced to check his shot, he gets an inside edge
full and driven straight to cover
tossed up and he drives him to mid-off
slower through the air again and he can only push it to the off side
very slow through the air and he can only defend

We have a run out and Chawla is the man, Bailey pulls it to short fine leg and they risk the single, Akshar was struggling and Chawla fired the throw to Uthappa who broke the stumps before Akshar dived
good bowling, he comes down the track and has to check his shot
bowls it flat and he goes back and flicks to deep midwicket
gives him width and he goes back and cuts to deep point
flatter and shorter and he rocks back and cuts to sweeper cover
he comes down the track and clips it wide of midwicket and scamper back for two
Bailey stays back and quietly defends this one
Chawla hits the timber with a sharp leg break, round the wicket, he bowled it flatter and Miller went back and across and looked to cut against the spin, comes back and castles middle and off
tossed up and he comes forward and drives this to mid-on

Kings XI are pegged back further here, found mid-off with precision, this was a fuller ball on the stumps and Saha made room to free his arms, got his placement all wrong as he scooped it straight to Umesh
the Morne slower bouncer again, he doesn't pick it well and he swings and misses
looks to beat the off side field  but can't beat backward point
he sees Miller advancing and cramps him up for room and he has to settle for a drill to long-on
fetched that from wide outside off and looks to pull but gets an inside edge
Morkel bangs it in short to Miller and he does well to keep it down and pull it to square leg
this was flatter and shorter and he looks to cut, ball keeps low and he misses
gets forward and drives him to long-off
bowls it short and he pulls him to deep midwicket
that's a clean slog! Tossed up and he gets on his knee and sends it a few rows over deep midwicket
drifts on the pads and he works it to deep square leg
short and wide and he looks to cut but misses
on the pads and he works it away behind square leg and they hurry the second run, Uthappa breaks the stumps but he is home
Dropped but a tough one for Pandey! This was short and wide outside off, Miller slashed hard to Pandey's right and he did really well to stop a boundary
fullish on the pads and he works it down to midwicket
the off cutter from Yadav and he was beaten
keeps it nice and straight and he pushes it down the track
a boundary at last, length ball and Saha fetches that from off stump and swings it towards deep midwicket, Yadav dives near the rope but can't stop it
gets on his knee and looks to sweep but doesn't make contact
works it towards deep square leg
stays back and clips it towards midwicket
sweeps him down to fine leg, Kings XI need boundaries
that was a good shout for lbw! Pitched on the off stump and turning back in slightly and Miller was a long way forward, looked like it would hit the middle stump, Miller was lucky
gets turn straightaway and he cuts to cover
this was fuller in length outside off and he drives to cover

he's got the Big Fish! This was quite straightforward, Yadav was angling it towards the leg stump, Maxwell shuffled and looked to paddle it, exposed the leg stump, struck in front and an easy decision
that's a good slower ball! Maxwell made room and was miles away from the ball
Maxwell gives him the charge and misses it completely, nowhere near the ball
short one on the body and he swivels to pull and he miscues it, fine leg picks up
confident shout for an lbw! This one nipped back in sharply and hit him high on the pad at the top flap, maybe a bit too high and Llong not convinced
swings it hard but finds short fine leg
good comeback by Narine as he sees him come down and bowls the off break, it turns and he is forced to check his shot
gets forward and pushes it towards mid-off
Maxwell targets the leg side and succeeds, length ball and he gets on his knee early and sweeps and one bounce to fine leg
Saha too quietly tucks it to the on side and settles for the single
Maxwell v Narine Ball 1 - he quietly pushes it towards mid-on
fortunately for KKR it's not a boundary, full ball on the stumps pushed to mid-on
wide down the leg side, KKR can't give them an opening like this

good catch by Yadav and how crucial will that be? Short of a length and Vohra was looking at the long-on boundary again, he miscues the pull and it's high in the air, Yadav backpedals from mid-on and takes it on the fall
shorter delivery from Morkel and he arches back and swishes but misses
fullish in length and he pushes it straight to mid-off
that was effortless! He gets forward and then goes back and launches a full ball with ease over long-on, free swing was enough
pulls a length ball straight to mid-on
he tucks it wide of square leg and we have a match on, it's drizzling, Kings XI get one thing out of the way
with that sweep to fine leg Kings XI have gone past the D/L score for five overs
he makes room and cuts it down to point and can't get the single
down the track and he pushes it towards cover, they are on par with the par score of 37
back to baclk! Tossed up and he comes forward and launches it high and over wide long-on
the initial target of 38 getting closer! Tossed up and he gets on his knee and slogs him clean over deep midwicket
fine shot to end the over and crucial too as Punjab look to be at least 37 at the end of 5 overs for the par score, on the pads and he gets on his knee and sweeps powerfully over square leg
keeps it quiet, pushed towards mid-on
clipped softly towards midwicket and they think of a second but there's a fumble, not worth risking
length ball on middle and leg and tucked to fine leg
just slides on the pads
slides down the leg side and he paddles it to short fine leg
that was a really good pick-up shot, fuller length on the pads, he shuffles and easily flicks it over fine leg
appeal for an lbw, Morkel has him in a tangle, yorker length and he is struck on the base of the pad, maybe sliding down leg
this was a fuller ball on the stumps and he shuffles and works it away down to deep midwicket
he stays beside the line and pushes it towards backward point
he gets across and punches it to the off side
clips it just wide of mid-on
down the leg side, swings and misses
he pushes it down to cover

appeal for a caught behind! Another good delivery by Umesh, this was pitched up and straightening and Saha was pushing at it, confident appeal, replays indicated a sound, Llong not convinced, lucky Saha, he looked back as well
he slides this one wide down the leg side
this was full and moving away and he drives to cover

that rocketed off the bat but straight to Shakib at cover, this was a pacy delivery by Umesh, short of a length, Sehwag had the width to punch it away but couldn't clear the infield, Shakib held his nerve and caught it with both hands
edged and drops short of slip, good delivery coming back in and he gets an outside edge that goes on the first bounce
Vohra gets bat on ball and it's a stylish flick over square leg but it drops short of the rope, didn't time it very well
this is top class bowling by Morkel, the previous one moved away and this one came back in and still squared him up, gets good bounce as well
Vohra is squared up by one that moved away late off the pitch, pokes his bat out
swings it towards the pads and he knocks it off the pads to square leg
Sehwag wastes no time in going for the big hit - at least trying, this was miscued and it lands over cover
